verdict.rationale: First-party docs show uploading notes in Word and attaching data in Excel to turn it into insights, plus the Analyst agent and code execution for calculations and graphs. Connectors can find and summarize files, including PDFs, from OneDrive and Google Drive, and one community user praises how it pulls data from across 365 documents. missing for 10: explicit documentation of direct PDF upload and analysis, in-depth docs beyond marketing one-liners, independent evidence of analysis accuracy.
